excerpt: Fig. 1. Scientific and news media articles on mindfulness and/or meditation by year from 1970 to 2015. Empirical scientific articles with the term mindfulness or meditation in the abstract, title, or keywords were searched using Scopus; media pieces with the term mindfulness or meditation in newspapers were searched using LexisNexis with a similarity filter.
overview: This figure is the paper’s central descriptive evidence for the claim that mindfulness moved rapidly from a fringe research topic into a saturated scientific and media discourse. It does not by itself prove that public claims are false, but it establishes the scale and timing of attention that makes hype, overgeneralization, and communication failures scientifically important.
title: Publication and Media Growth
